segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for the calibration management rollout and make sure it matches what you need for the April go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, thanks. We reviewed it with operations yesterday. The 38 full users and 22 read-only seats look right for phase one.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. The quote has those 60 total seats, implementation support, and the data import for your existing gauge list. Annual subscription comes to $48,600, and services are $9,800 one-time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that lines up with what I saw. On implementation, are you still estimating six weeks?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have the signed order by March 8, kickoff would be the week of March 11, configuration and import in March, admin training April 9, and go-live April 15.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Procurement asked about payment terms. We usually do net 45, not net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 45 is fine for your account. I’ll have that reflected in the final order form. The subscription term would run April 15, 2026 through April 14, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. And the invoice, would that issue at signature or at go-live?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: At subscription start, so April 15. The services portion would be invoiced at kickoff, week of March 11.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Send the final order form with net 45, and I’ll route it today. I don’t expect any redlines.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send it over within the hour, and if anything comes up from procurement, just forward it to me.
